hook: On Heavy Nights, Don't Fight the Feeling

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Some nights, for no reason, <#0.2#> your heart just sinks.
voices.caption: Some nights, for no reason, your heart just sinks.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Usually we grab our phone <#0.2#> to make it go away.
voices.caption: Usually we grab our phone to make it go away.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Instead, just watch it. <#0.3#> Ah, I'm experiencing this feeling right now.
voices.caption: Instead, just watch it. Ah, I'm experiencing this feeling right now.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: And ask: <#0.2#> is this truly mine?
voices.caption: And ask: is this truly mine?

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Whatever it is, accept it. <#0.2#> That's you too.
voices.caption: Whatever it is, accept it. That's you too.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: When you stop fighting your feelings, <#0.3#> you become almost absurdly free.
voices.caption: When you stop fighting your feelings, you become almost absurdly free.
